Readiness code\L\S\K\N
The \L\B\K\Nreadiness code\L\S\K\N is an 8-digit numerical code showing the status of exhaust-relevant tests.
When a system's test has finished, the corresponding digit in the code is set to 0.(0 test performed, 1 test not performed)
The tests are performed at regular intervals in normal driving mode.
After repair work on an exhaust-relevant component or system, it is recommended to generate the \L\B\K\Nreadiness code\L\S\K\N and query the fault memory, in order to guarantee that these systems are working properly.
After the \L\B\K\Nreadiness code\L\S\K\N has been generated, the fault memory of the engine control unit must not be erased any more or else the readiness code will also be erased again.
